newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products gain except lacklustre fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products gain except lacklustre fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Tuesday morning as futures gained, except fuel oil which failed to rise from Monday's close, dealers said.
Gasoline was up by about $1 a tonne, offered at $189 fob Rotterdam. Bids were at about $186 fob.

Heating oil gained $1/$2 as IPE gas oil futures strengthened. Premiums were unchanged, either side of IPE July +50 cents fob Rotterdam. Traders said there was a slight shortage of product, but little sign of German barge buying.
High sulphur fuel oil barges failed to trade in early session. Offers were at around $84.50/$85 fob Rotterdam, as at Monday's close. Bunker demand was moderate.
